headline: A 2010 executive order set up a federal interagency group focused on US insular areas, also known as US territories.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates an Interagency Group on Insular Areas. "Insular areas" usually means US territories such as Guam, American Samoa, the US Virgin Islands, and the Northern Mariana Islands. The group appears meant to bring federal agencies together on issues affecting these places. No summary was provided, so details on the group's members, duties, and powers are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: People who live in US territories
who_it_affects.how: Federal agencies would coordinate through a dedicated group on policies that affect their communities.
Agencies would likely take part in a shared group to work together on territory-related issues.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 14, 2010; the title alone does not state an effective date.
